final_draft.answer: Yes. Our AWS account (111122223333) blocks all public access to S3 buckets account-wide.
final_draft.note: The answer uses the approved wording from security@harborlight.example (control CC6.6, valid until 2027-11-17). A read-only check of the live setting on 2026-11-17 at 01:15 UTC confirmed it. AWS account 111122223333 had all four S3 public access block settings turned on account-wide: blocking public ACLs, ignoring public ACLs, blocking public policies and restricting public buckets. The approved answer and the check only cover account 111122223333. If the company has other AWS accounts, nothing here shows whether the same block applies to them.
